liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Dark Star** (4 reviews): Reviewer calls this an exceptionally jazzy Dark Star and compares it with the 9/11/73 version; Reviewer heard the circulating soundboard of Weather Report Suite into Dark Star and found the jazz-fusion jamming exceptional, unlike other 1973 jams [10][12][18][20]
- **Playing In The Band** (2 reviews): Reviewer calls Playin' following Eyes Of The World a mind-bending second highlight showing Garcia's inspiration; Reviewer finds the Playin' unreal [18][20]
- **They Love Each Other** (1 review): Reviewer finds this version not the peppiest or best, but it cruises at a nice tempo with good licks between verses [13]

## The recordings

- **gd1973-03-28.sbd.mtx.tobin.86833.sbeok.flac16** (recommended): matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 30 songs; 224 min; rated 4.67/5 by 3 [1]. Said about its sound: Minor digital noise in early Cumberland Blues; quality improves on disc 3. Cassette has a Loser cut fixed by crossfade [1]
- **gd1973-03-28.mtx.dts.tobin.86896.sbeok.flac16**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 30 songs; 224 min [2]. Said about its sound: Minor digital noise in opening Cumberland Blues; quality improves on disc 3; first two notes of Around And Around are cut [2]
- **gd73-03-28.sbd-aud.cotsman.11473.sbeok.shnf**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 30 songs; 203 min; rated 4/5 by 15 [6]. Said about its sound: Soundboard-sourced third disc avoids the audience sections' quality problems; the audience parts have issues, and the band sounds tight; Weather Report Suite Prelude through Johnny B. Goode is of soundboard quality in this matrix [16][18]
- **gd73-03-28.aud-nourse.weiner.16886.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 31 songs; 201 min; rated 4.38/5 by 13 [7]. Said about its sound: Reviewer streamed only the opening Cumberland Blues and found the sound fine, comparable or better than the other available source; Audience recording is weak at times but still conveys the music; reviewer rates the sound mediocre; Reviewer finds the audience recording poor quality, hard on the ears, though the performance is strong [11][14][15][17]

## Around the show

- A talkative taper or nearby audience member adds running commentary audible on the recording [14]
- The show was officially released as Dave's Picks Volume 16 [24]
- Reviewer says this Dark Star is hard to top and points to the 9/11/73 version as a comparison [10]
- Reviewer ranks this jam among the all-time greatest Dead jams, alongside Ithaca 77 St. Stephen>NFA and 5/11/72 Dark Star [12]
- Reviewer says the spring 1973 New England show offers three and a half hours of rollicking music with few slow songs [26]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1973-03-28.sbd.mtx.tobin.86833.sbeok.flac16**: taped by See info file; transferred by Matrix by Kevin Tobin; source: SBD + AUD Matrix 2 Source Mix (65%-SBD/35%-AUD) [1]. Also: Soundboard to master reel to DAT, transferred with Sony 500 and Samplitude 9.11 into FLAC by Charlie Miller; A cassette master supplements it, run through Apogee MiniMe and Samplitude 8.01; first part of Cumberland Blues is missing there [1]
- **gd1973-03-28.mtx.dts.tobin.86896.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Kevin Tobin; source: SBD(86459) + AUD(74682) [2]. Also: Soundboard to master reel to DAT, transferred with Sony 500 and Samplitude 9.11 into FLAC by Charlie Miller; Cassette master via Apogee MiniMe and Samplitude 8.01 fills gaps; first part of Cumberland Blues is missing from it [2]
- **gd73-03-28.sbd-aud.cotsman.11473.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by J Cotsman; source: Soundboard and Audience composite [6]. Also: Matrix uses soundboard for the third disc, Weather Report Suite Prelude through Johnny B. Goode, and audience elsewhere; Matrix seeded to etree by J Cotsman [6][16]
- **gd73-03-28.aud-nourse.weiner.16886.sbeok.shnf**: source: Audience Recording [7]. Also: Third disc, Weather Report Suite Prelude through Johnny B. Goode, is from soundboard, while the rest is audience; Audience recording by taper Andy Nourse, equipment unknown, via Noah Weiner, transferred through DAT to WAV to SHN [7][17]

## Art and photos

- Fan art by www.livebootleg.net: [コレクターズCD grateful dead(グレトフルデッド73年アメリカツアー）Civic Center Springfield](https://www.livebootleg.net/SHOP/GratefulDead0008.html) [27]
- Poster by Jerry Garcia: [1973-03-28 Ticket - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/image/1973-03-28-ticket/) [28]
